title: LLM Test Generation via Iterative Hybrid Program Analysis
summary: The original Panta pipeline generates unit tests via iterative hybrid program analysis, combining static control-flow analysis with LLM calls to progressively target uncovered branches across Defects4J Java classes, measuring line and branch coverage via JaCoCo.
This reproduction replaces the iterative hybrid analysis loop with a direct test generation prompt over sampled Defects4J classes.
